name: agent-workbench
description: Portable task orchestration and evidence-backed agent loop discovery with independent verification.

interface.shortDescription: Route work and discover safe agent loops
interface.longDescription: Agent Workbench coordinates bounded, independently verified subagent work and discovers recurring work that may be suitable for safe agent loops. Deterministic readiness gates produce proposal-only loop contracts that remain inactive until separately authorized by a human.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Workbench to orchestrate this task through bounded subagents.
Use Agent Workbench to route this risky change and require independent verification.
Use Agent Workbench to discover recurring work and draft a safe loop proposal.
